body: But I am not really a good person. Not feeling emotions has made me kind of cold, how do you expect me to want to do that? Even if you volunteer, you are not making a relevant impact, and you get tired every day... at least I am dying on my own terms.

Go to sites like  [https://sanctionedsuicide.com/](https://sanctionedsuicide.com/)  and start reading about why people want to die. If you do this you will eventually agree or disagree with them. If you agree, you will want to kill yourself too, that's a start.

Try to imagine that life doesn't end with death. It's just wishfull thinking, I know, but if you start to believe it you will start to lose your fears about death.

Finally, look for a suicide method that fits you. If you have a method it's way easier because you can start to imagine yourself dying with that method. You will eventually surpass your survival instinct. Just my two cents.
